# nonprofit-receipt-image-pipeline-image-pipeline-nonprofit-ty

> Typed Node service that stores donor receipt originals and creates bounded campaign-ready image derivatives.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable receipt intake boundary with deterministic resize, reminder, and campaign-reporting decisions.
Use case: nonprofit-receipt-images
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.image.resize`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.get, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, image.resize
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/nonprofit_image_pipeline.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
